updates.title: Market Update
updates.content: The S&P 500 index continues to hover near all-time highs, despite a lack of conviction in the market as evidenced by low trading volume.

updates.title: Current Developments
updates.content: The recent presidential debate has introduced significant uncertainty in the American economy and US international standing, while the latest PCE data came in as expected, with headline PCE at 0.0% and core PCE at 0.1%.

updates.title: Market Reactions
updates.content: The market's reaction to the uncertainty has been muted, with the S&P 500 experiencing a slight pullback, while oil prices have surged to a 3-month high driven by seasonal demand and supply disruptions.

updates.title: Portfolio Strategy
updates.content: A diversified long-term investor should consider maintaining a balanced portfolio, focusing on sectors that are less exposed to the current uncertainty, such as mega-cap stocks and energy stocks.

updates.title: Looking Ahead
updates.content: Next week, investors should keep an eye on the market's reaction to the ongoing uncertainty and potential changes in the portfolios, as well as the impact of the record-breaking US travel demand on the economy.
